name: Hollow Memory Thief
loreTies: A thin assassin that steals the memory of a Deity’s last tactic, forcing the active deity to adapt instead of repeat.
Targets repeated player actions and disrupts cooldown rhythm.
Erasure is not death; erasure is ownership without memory.
shortBackstory: Hollow Memory Thief is a Hollow threat creature built for campaign and event encounters, turning erased memory into major battlefield pressure.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Hollow Memory Thief formed where the Hollow learned a specific weakness in remembered civilization. It is not a Deity, not a citizen, and not a recruitable unit; it is a symptom of the Gate giving absence a body.

chapters.title: Hollow Function
chapters.text: Its role inside the Hollow threat faction is precise: Targets repeated player actions and disrupts cooldown rhythm. This lets mission designers select it by encounter tags instead of treating Hollow enemies as one shapeless swarm.

chapters.title: Lore Tie
chapters.text: A thin assassin that steals the memory of a Deity’s last tactic, forcing the active deity to adapt instead of repeat.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: Hollow Memory Thief can appear in Normal missions, Elite remixes, Hollow Breach events, Ascension floors, and raid add waves when its tags match the objective pressure. It must always reinforce Hollowing: isolation, corrupted memory, broken objectives, or stolen meaning.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Art and gameplay must keep Hollow Memory Thief visibly non-playable. Its silhouette uses slender black blade-limbed figure, empty face veil, stolen glyphs orbiting its fingers, quiet white eye-cracks. while its abilities — Steal Pattern, Cooldown Forgetting, Backstab Silence — create battlefield pressure without confusing it for a faction Deity.

developmentStatus: Readable Hollow creature profile integrated into campaign/event threat pages.
